description:
‘Former Child Actor Seo Yoon-seo Comes Out?!’

That single rumor completely shattered Yoon-seo’s life.
As the rumors spiraled further and further out of control,
castings were canceled,
billboards were torn down,
and his ruined image
even led to lawsuits for damages.

Just as he reached a dead end with absolutely nowhere left to run—
He met the man who would shake up his life once again:
Choi Do-young.

“When you make a face like that, Seo Yoon-seo, it makes me feel like a total bastard.”

“D-Director... wait a minute.”

“You shouldn't treat the great Choi Do-young like a dog, now should you?”

Eyes drenched in desire gleamed intensely.
Even without him going this far, Yoon-seo already knew that the man coveting him was none other than Choi Do-young.

“Seo Yoon-seo.”

A husky, low voice pierced his eardrums.

“Let go. Before you get hurt.”
